## Overview

In BaZi (Four Pillars of Destiny), the Day Master is the Heavenly Stem of your birth day. It stands for you — the core self around which everything else in the chart is read. Yours is Ren 壬 (Yang Water): the image is a broad, moving body of water, resourceful, adaptable and drawn to wide horizons. You were born in the Hai 亥 (Pig) month, which is winter, when water is at its strongest season. Your month pillar is Yi Hai 乙亥, with Hurting Officer (expressive, inventive output that wants to show itself) on the stem and Friend (peer support and self-assertion) hidden in the branch.

Even so, your Day Master comes out **weak**, with a share of supporting elements of 47.6 percent. That may sound close to half, but look at the spread: water is the largest element at 35.9 percent, yet wood is strong at 25.3 percent, earth at 20 percent and metal only 11.8 percent, with fire at 7.1 percent. Wood drains water by expressing it, and earth controls it — together they pull more out of you than the chart puts back. That is why your favorable elements are **metal** (which feeds water) and **water** (which strengthens you), while **fire, earth and wood** are unfavorable and are best met in moderate doses.

The central theme is a generous, expressive nature that gives out more than it retains. Metal shows up in your chart mainly through the Geng 庚 (Yang Metal) hour stem, Indirect Resource (the quiet, reflective, learning side of the mind). Your work is to let that reflective metal and the steady support of water keep your reserves full, so your natural flow of ideas and kindness does not run dry.

## Personality

The most visible expression in your chart is the Hurting Officer on the month stem in Yi Hai. Hurting Officer is the Ten God of originality, sharp observation and the urge to say things your own way. Sitting in the month pillar — the pillar of your working life and how you meet the world — it suggests you are someone who notices what others miss, dislikes being boxed in by routine, and often improves on the standard method simply because it bothers you not to. The residual hidden stem in your year branch, Yi, is also Hurting Officer, so this expressive streak runs through both how you present yourself publicly and how you work.

Underneath that, your day branch is Yin 寅 (Tiger), which holds Eating God as its main hidden stem — a gentler, more savoring kind of creativity, plus Indirect Wealth and Seven Killings (pressure, challenge and the drive it creates) in its middle and residual positions. Eating God gives you an appetite for craft, good food, and doing things properly for their own sake; Seven Killings hidden here means you carry a quiet reserve of stamina for pressure that people may not see until you need it. The Geng hour stem, Indirect Resource, adds a reflective streak — a mind that likes to withdraw, read, study and work things out alone before showing anyone.

The habit worth adjusting is over-giving. With a weak Day Master and a chart heavy in wood and earth, you may agree, explain and produce faster than you recharge. The People-Pleasing pattern is not vanity — it is genuine warmth — but pacing yourself, and letting some requests wait, helps your best qualities stay available.

## Career

Your month pillar, Yi Hai, is where career tendencies are clearest. Hurting Officer on the month stem points to work that rewards insight, communication, design, teaching, analysis or any role where you can improve a system rather than simply operate it. Hurting Officer people tend to chafe under heavy hierarchy, and your year pillar's Direct Officer (the Ten God of structure, rules and steady responsibility) in Ji 己 (Yin Earth) suggests that formal structures have shaped your life — perhaps family expectations or early institutional settings — even if they are not where you feel most yourself.

The favorable metal in your chart is thin but present, through the Geng hour stem (Indirect Resource) and, from 2022, the Geng Chen 庚辰 Luck Pillar. Metal is what gives water direction and form, so learning, credentials, mentors, research and accumulated expertise are your strongest career allies: the more you know deeply, the more freely your creativity can move. Your Prosperity Star (Lu Shen) touches the Hai month branch, which traditionally marks the working environment as a place of steady earning rather than dramatic swings.

Watch for the tendency to take on the expressive, problem-solving role in every room. The Hurting Officer's gift is insight; its cost is being the one who always has an answer. Building in behind-the-scenes time — the kind the Indirect Resource hour favors — lets your contributions land with more weight and less exhaustion.

## Wealth

Money in your chart is shaped by Indirect Wealth, which appears as the main hidden stem of your day branch, Yin, and again as the stem Ten God of the current 2026 year. Indirect Wealth is the Ten God of opportunity income, side ventures, royalties and gains that arrive from initiative rather than a fixed wage. Because it sits in your day branch — the closest pillar to you — it suggests that your financial life is closely tied to personal effort and your own ideas rather than to an employer's timetable.

Direct Wealth also shows in the year pillar's middle hidden stem, Ding, and in the current Geng Chen Luck Pillar's stem Ten God, Direct Wealth, which describes steady, methodical earnings. Fire, the element of Direct Wealth here, is unfavorable for your weak Day Master, so the rhythm that suits you is not chasing every opportunity but choosing a few and letting them mature. Your favorable metal and water support clear thinking and patience; those are better wealth tools for you than speed.

Practically, the pattern points to keeping a visible gap between income arriving and commitments going out. With a weak Day Master, financial overextension tends to feel like emotional overextension — you notice it as tiredness before you notice it on paper. A regular review of what you have committed to, and room to say no to new obligations, suits both your chart and your peace of mind.

## Love and Relationships

Your day branch, Yin, is the traditional seat of close partnership, and it is a busy one: Eating God as the main hidden stem, with Indirect Wealth and Seven Killings tucked inside. Eating God in this position suggests that you show love through care — cooking, making things comfortable, sharing enjoyment — and that you appreciate a partner with warmth, humor and a taste for life's pleasures. The hidden Seven Killings adds a wish for a partner who is capable and has some edge, someone whose strength you respect rather than manage.

The Hurting Officer on the month stem has a particular flavor in relationships: honesty. You tend to say what you think, which is a gift when it is kind and a strain when it lands harder than intended. Direct Officer — the Ten God of committed structure, visible in your year pillar stem in Ji — suggests that formal commitment and reliability matter to you, even as the expressive side resists being regulated. The balance is a partner who values your directness but with whom you have agreed ways to raise difficult things gently.

The Peach Blossom star touches the Zi 子 (Rat) hour branch, which traditionally adds charm and social ease to how you come across, and the Nobleman (Tian Yi Gui Ren — helpful people and timely support) touches that same Zi branch. Together they point to relationships that grow through social circles and through people who step in to help at the right moment. Giving close relationships the same reflective space your Indirect Resource hour enjoys — quiet, unhurried conversation rather than fast resolution — tends to suit you well.

## Wellbeing Habits

Your chart is water-rich (35.9 percent) with meaningful wood (25.3 percent) and earth (20 percent), while metal is the scarcest at 11.8 percent and fire is faint at 7.1 percent. Metal and water are your favorable elements, so routines that quietly restore rather than expend suit you best.

- **Sleep:** protect it. With a weak Day Master, sleep is your main recharge, and a regular wind-down — dim light, no screens, a few pages of a book — echoes the reflective metal of your hour pillar.
- **Food:** warm, grounding, simple meals at regular times. Eating God in your day branch enjoys good food; the habit worth keeping is eating slowly and stopping before you are over-full.
- **Movement:** gentle and rhythmic — walking, swimming, cycling. Water is your favorable element, and steady movement that does not leave you drained replenishes more than it costs.
- **Emotional routine:** a short daily pause to notice what you have taken on. With Hurting Officer prominent, expressing things is easy; checking in with yourself before you speak is the habit that keeps your reserves intact.

If you feel unwell, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.

## Current Luck Pillar

A Luck Pillar is a ten-year cycle, set by the Heavenly Stem and Earthly Branch that follow your month pillar, which colors the overall rhythm of that decade. You are in your **Geng Chen 庚辰 Luck Pillar**, which runs from 2022 to 2031 (ages 44 to 53, traditional East Asian counting). Geng is Yang Metal, and its Ten God is Indirect Resource — the favorable, reflective, learning side of your chart; Chen is a Dragon branch, whose main hidden stem carries Seven Killings, which is unfavorable. So this decade has a mixed character: the stem supports you, the branch applies pressure.

In practice, the Geng stem is the headline. Indirect Resource is the Ten God of study, research, quiet expertise and trusting your own inner counsel — exactly what a weak Yang Water Day Master needs. These years favor going deeper rather than wider: training, reading, refining a craft, and building the kind of knowledge that gives your creativity a channel. The Seven Killings in Chen asks you to handle more responsibility and pace yourself through it; pressure in this decade tends to build slowly rather than arrive all at once.

The next Luck Pillar, **Xin Si 辛巳** (2032 to 2041), shifts the emphasis. Xin is Yin Metal, Direct Resource — still favorable, but gentler and more focused on steady support and mentoring — while Si is a Snake branch whose main hidden stem is Indirect Wealth, which is unfavorable. The decade could lean more toward tangible opportunity and less toward quiet study, so the habit to carry forward is keeping some protected time for reflection even as activity increases.

## Year by Year

Each Chinese solar year begins at Li Chun, the start of spring, and so it runs close to — but not exactly with — the calendar year. The years below follow that solar reckoning; all of them sit inside your Geng Chen Luck Pillar, with no change of Luck Pillar in this window.

### 2026 丙午 · Bing Wu

This year's stem is Bing 丙 (Yang Fire), carrying Indirect Wealth, and its branch is Wu 午 (Horse), whose main hidden stem is Direct Wealth with Direct Officer beneath it. Both are unfavorable elements, so the year's tone tilts toward outward activity, visibility and opportunity — more than your weak Day Master ideally likes to carry at once. Bing Wu forms a six harmony with your year branch Wei, a three-harmony grouping with your day branch Yin, and a clash with your hour branch Zi.

What is worth leaning into is the opportunity side of Indirect Wealth: new openings, side projects, ideas that come from your own initiative. What deserves care is pacing. The clash with your hour branch touches your reflective, private side — routines and quiet time could feel more disrupted — while the groupings with your year and day branches pull you into social and close-relationship matters. Keep the second half of the year lighter where you can, and let the metal-and-water habits do their work.

### 2027 丁未 · Ding Wei

Ding 丁 (Yin Fire) is Direct Wealth on the stem, and Wei 未 (Goat) carries Direct Officer as its main hidden stem, with Direct Wealth and Hurting Officer inside. Both are unfavorable. This year also brings Tai Sui — the year branch matches your own year branch, Wei — which traditionally marks a year of more change and adjustment rather than anything dramatic. Ding combines with your Day Master Ren on the stem, and Wei forms a three-harmony grouping with your month branch Hai.

The tone is steady and responsibility-heavy: Direct Wealth and Direct Officer together favor orderly work, commitments and visible reliability. Lean into structure — finishing things, keeping promises, tidying loose ends. Because Tai Sui years ask for flexibility, leave margin in your plans and avoid over-committing early in the year. The stem combination with your Day Master suggests personal matters come to the foreground; talk things through rather than deciding quickly.

### 2028 戊申 · Wu Shen

Wu 戊 (Yang Earth) is Seven Killings on the stem — unfavorable — while Shen 申 (Monkey) carries Indirect Resource as its main hidden stem, which is favorable. This is a year of pressure on the surface and support underneath: the stem asks more of you, the branch quietly restores you. Shen clashes with and punishes your day branch Yin, and forms a three-harmony grouping with both your hour branch Zi and your Geng Chen Luck Pillar branch.

Lean into the Shen side: learning, research, behind-the-scenes work, and anything that builds your expertise. The clash and punishment with your day branch suggest that routines and close relationships may feel more changeable this year, so slow down and talk things through rather than reacting in the moment. The three-harmony groupings are a helpful signature — they tend to smooth the way — so use the support around you.

### 2029 己酉 · Ji You

Ji 己 (Yin Earth) is Direct Officer on the stem, unfavorable, while You 酉 (Rooster) holds Direct Resource as its main hidden stem, which is favorable and quietly nourishing. You forms a six harmony with the Chen branch of your current Luck Pillar, a cooperative signature that tends to make the year flow more easily.

The tone is orderly and reflective at once: Direct Officer favors structure, duty and visible progress; Direct Resource favors study, mentoring and steady support. Lean into anything that combines the two — a course with a clear goal, a role with defined responsibilities, working alongside someone more experienced. The main thing to watch is the earth on the stem, which drains your water: keep your commitments realistic and guard your rest.

### 2030 庚戌 · Geng Xu

Geng 庚 (Yang Metal) is Indirect Resource on the stem — favorable and supportive — while Xu 戌 (Dog) carries Seven Killings as its main hidden stem, with Direct Resource and Direct Wealth inside, making the branch unfavorable overall. Geng combines with your month stem Yi, Xu punishes your year branch Wei, forms a three-harmony grouping with your day branch Yin, and clashes with the Chen branch of your current Luck Pillar.

The stem is the good news: a favorable year for reflection, learning and trusting your own judgment. The branch asks for stamina and brings change — the clash with your Luck Pillar branch suggests this year may feel like a turning point within the decade, and the three-harmony grouping with your day branch keeps close relationships supportive. Lean into the metal: study, mentors, and finishing what you started. Approach the second half of the year with more room in the schedule.

## Guidance

- **Build a regular study or deep-learning habit.** Metal is your most favorable element and your scarcest at 11.8 percent, and the Geng Chen Luck Pillar's Indirect Resource stem rewards exactly this kind of quiet expertise.
- **Protect sleep and wind-down time.** Your Day Master is weak with a share of supporting elements of 47.6 percent, so rest is not a luxury — it is what keeps your Hurting Officer expressiveness generous rather than depleted.
- **Keep commitments to a number you can carry.** Earth and wood together (20 and 25.3 percent) drain your water; a short weekly review of what you have agreed to makes over-extension visible before it becomes tiredness.
- **Leave margin in plans for 2027.** That year brings Tai Sui and a stem combination with your Day Master, so build flexibility into your schedule and talk personal matters through before deciding.
- **Make space for close-relationship conversations in 2028.** The year branch clashes with and punishes your day branch Yin, so unhurried, honest conversation that year is worth more than quick answers.
